  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def calibrate_affine_load(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *, archive_panels: tuple[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], ...] = (), residual_fraction: float = 1e-3, span_fraction: float = 0.1) -> tuple[float, float, bool]:
    """Return positive gain, physical bias, and whether the archive was used.

    All panels are for one load cell, in common stress units. Archive sweeps
    are ordered oldest to newest. Defaults require a residual of at most
    0.001 and an inlier command span of at least 0.10, both relative to
    stress_scale. Refit strict-majority consensuses without a ridge. Prefer
    four local inliers; with an archive, admit three and break local ties by
    proximity to the archive. If the slope must transfer, update its bias
    only with current checks within three residual tolerances of the anchor.
    """
    if not np.isfinite([stress_scale, residual_fraction, span_fraction]).all() or min(stress_scale, residual_fraction, span_fraction) <= 0:
        raise ValueError('stress scale and fractions must be finite and positive')

    def clean(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
        if a.ndim != 1 or b.shape != a.shape:
            raise ValueError('load-cell checks must be matching vectors')
        keep = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
        return a[keep] / stress_scale, b[keep] / stress_scale

    def consensus(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, minimum: int, prior: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None:
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        dx = x[j] - x[i]
        keep = np.abs(dx) > np.sqrt(np.finfo(float).eps) * span_fraction
        i, j, dx = i[keep], j[keep], dx[keep]
        g = (y[j] - y[i]) / dx
        i, g = i[g > 0], g[g > 0]
        if not g.size:
            return None
        b = y[i] - g * x[i]
        r = np.abs(y - g[:, None] * x - b[:, None])
        mask = r <= residual_fraction
        count = mask.sum(axis=1)
        width = np.max(np.where(mask, x, -np.inf), axis=1) - np.min(np.where(mask, x, np.inf), axis=1)
        eligible = (count >= max(minimum, x.size // 2 + 1)) & (width >= span_fraction)
        q = np.flatnonzero(eligible)
        if not q.size:
            return None
        penalty = -width if prior is None else np.abs(g - prior[0]) + np.abs(b - prior[1])
        err = np.where(mask, r, 0.).sum(axis=1)
        k = q[np.lexsort((err[q], penalty[q], -count[q]))[0]]
        m = mask[k]
        coef = np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[x[m], np.ones(m.sum())], y[m], rcond=None)[0]
        return (coef, m) if coef[0] > 0 else None

    x, y = clean(command, measured)
    local = consensus(x, y, 4)
    if local is not None:
        return float(local[0][0]), float(local[0][1] * stress_scale), False
    prior = None
    recent = []
    for a, b in reversed(archive_panels):
        xa, ya = clean(a, b)
        fit = consensus(xa, ya, 4, prior)
        if fit is None:
            continue
        coef, m = fit
        if prior is None:
            prior = coef
        elif np.max(np.abs(ya[m] - prior[0] * xa[m] - prior[1])) > 3 * residual_fraction:
            break
        recent.append((xa[m], ya[m]))
    if prior is None:
        raise ValueError('unsupported current calibration; supply qualified same-cell archive sweeps')
    if len(recent) > 1:
        xa, ya = (np.concatenate(part) for part in zip(*recent))
        pooled = consensus(xa, ya, 4, prior)
        if pooled is not None:
            prior = pooled[0]
    local = consensus(x, y, 3, prior)
    if local is not None:
        return float(local[0][0]), float(local[0][1] * stress_scale), True
    gain, bias = prior
    delta = y - gain * x - bias
    near = np.abs(delta) <= 3 * residual_fraction
    if near.any():
        bias += np.median(delta[near])
    return float(gain), float(bias * stress_scale), True


def align_reference_features(features: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Remove a shared positive affine measurement transform per group.

    References are row-aligned and composition-comparable across groups.
    Use medians of per-column means and population spreads from reference
    columns with at least two finite observations. Fill missing aligned
    values with equal-weight observed group-stratum cell means per feature;
    a feature absent everywhere receives zero. There is no shrinkage. Pass
    all allowed unlabeled cohorts together for transductive alignment.
    """
    x, ref = np.asarray(features, float), np.asarray(reference, float)
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not len(x) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape:
        raise ValueError('features, references, groups and strata must share a nonempty row axis')
    gi = np.unique(g, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    si = np.unique(s, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    aligned = np.full(x.shape, np.nan)
    for k in np.unique(gi):
        rows = gi == k
        panel = ref[rows]
        finite = np.isfinite(panel)
        cols = finite.sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not cols.any():
            raise ValueError('group lacks a supported reference column')
        panel = np.where(finite[:, cols], panel[:, cols], np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        spread = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite([center, spread]).all() or spread <= 0:
            raise ValueError('group needs finite reference moments and positive spread')
        aligned[rows] = (np.where(np.isfinite(x[rows]), x[rows], np.nan) - center) / spread
    cell = np.unique(np.c_[gi, si], axis=0, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    keep = np.isfinite(aligned)
    total = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    supported = np.zeros(x.shape[1], dtype=int)
    for k in np.unique(cell):
        rows = cell == k
        n = keep[rows].sum(axis=0)
        total += np.divide(np.nansum(aligned[rows], axis=0), n, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=n > 0)
        supported += n > 0
    fill = np.divide(total, supported, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=supported > 0)
    return np.where(keep, aligned, fill)


def fit_thresholded_creep(past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, strain0: np.ndarray, strain_obs: np.ndarray, rate_obs: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *, rank_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit two hereditary modes, affine feature drift, and two yield terms.

    The (N,H) history is piecewise constant, oldest first, with shared
    durations and zero prehistory memory. Stresses are calibrated and share
    units; durations, evaluation times, and tau bounds share a time unit.
    Rates are strain per that time unit. Use NaN for missing observations or
    prediction-only rows. Both observation families must have finite data.

    Return ordered taus, hereditary coefficients [fast, slow, drift
    intercept, drift slopes...], plastic coefficients [hold, history],
    absolute strain curves, and initial rates for all rows. Coefficients
    multiply physical, unnormalized stresses and times. A plastic column
    that vanishes on observed equations is fixed at zero, not inferred.
    Use bounded log-times, no coefficient ridge, a final Cauchy cutoff of
    two MAD scales per observation family, and a local weighted rank gate.
    """
    past, hold, dt, t, x, e0, curves, rates = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float), (past_stress, hold_stress, durations, times, features, strain0, strain_obs, rate_obs))
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    if not np.isfinite([lo, hi, yield_stress, rank_rtol]).all() or not (0 < lo < hi and yield_stress > 0 and 0 < rank_rtol < 1):
        raise ValueError('invalid tau bounds, yield stress or rank tolerance')
    if past.ndim != 2 or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size:
        raise ValueError('expected a stress history matrix and time vector')
    n, h = past.shape
    if dt.shape != (h,) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n or curves.shape != (n, t.size) or any(a.shape != (n,) for a in (hold, e0, rates)):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent history, feature or observation shapes')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (past, hold, dt, t, x, e0)) or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0):
        raise ValueError('inputs must be finite with nonnegative times and durations')
    ts = np.exp((np.log(lo) + np.log(hi)) / 2)
    zlo, zhi = np.log(np.array([lo, hi]) / ts)
    dt, t = dt / ts, t / ts
    ss = yield_stress
    past, hold = past / ss, hold / ss
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if h else dt
    X = np.c_[np.ones(n), x]
    ov = np.sign(hold) * np.maximum(np.abs(hold) - 1., 0.)**2
    work = (np.maximum(np.abs(past) - 1., 0.)**2 @ dt) * hold
    y = np.c_[curves - e0[:, None], rates * ts]
    valid = np.isfinite(y)
    vc, vr = valid[:, :-1], valid[:, -1]
    if not vc.any() or not vr.any():
        raise ValueError('both curve and initial-rate observations are required')
    ys = max(np.median(np.abs(y[:, :-1][vc])), np.median(np.abs(y[:, -1][vr])))
    if ys == 0:
        ys = np.max(np.abs(y[valid]))
    if ys == 0:
        raise ValueError('zero response does not identify relaxation times')
    target = y[valid] / ys
    base = 2 + X.shape[1]
    use_hold = np.any((ov[:, None] * t)[vc]) or np.any(ov[vr])
    use_work = np.any(work[:, None][vc.any(axis=1) & (vc @ (t > 0) > 0)]) or np.any(work[vr])
    keep = np.r_[np.ones(base, dtype=bool), use_hold, use_work]
    nc = int(keep.sum())
    if target.size < nc + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient observations for the active constitutive terms')

    def design(z: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        tau = np.exp(z)
        a, b = after[:, None] / tau, dt[:, None] / tau
        ea, eb = np.exp(-a), np.exp(-b)
        kernel = ea * -np.expm1(-b)
        d = hold[:, None] - past @ kernel
        dd = -past @ (a * kernel - ea * b * eb)
        u = t[:, None] / tau
        f, ue = -np.expm1(-u), u * np.exp(-u)
        A = np.empty((n, t.size + 1, base + 2))
        A[:, :-1, :2] = d[:, None, :] * f
        A[:, :-1, 2:base] = X[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]
        A[:, :-1, base] = ov[:, None] * t
        A[:, :-1, base + 1] = work[:, None] * f[:, 0]
        A[:, -1] = np.c_[d / tau, X, ov, work / tau[0]]
        dcurve = dd[:, None, :] * f - d[:, None, :] * ue
        G = np.concatenate((dcurve, ((dd - d) / tau)[:, None, :]), axis=1)
        W = work[:, None] * np.r_[-ue[:, 0], -1. / tau[0]]
        return A, G, W

    def logs(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.array([p[0], p[0] + p[1] * (zhi - p[0])])

    def sigma(curve: float, rate: float) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.full(t.size, curve), rate], y.shape)[valid]

    scale = sigma(1., 1.5)
    bounds = (np.r_[zlo, 0., np.full(nc, -np.inf)], np.r_[zhi, 1., np.full(nc, np.inf)])

    def fun(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        A, _, _ = design(logs(p))
        return (A[valid][:, keep] @ p[2:] - target) / scale

    def direct_jac(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        A, G, W = design(logs(p))
        B = G[valid] * p[2:4]
        if use_work:
            B[:, 0] += W[valid] * p[-1]
        return np.c_[B, A[valid][:, keep]] / scale[:, None]

    def jac(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        J = direct_jac(p)
        return np.c_[J[:, 0] + (1. - p[1]) * J[:, 1], (zhi - p[0]) * J[:, 1], J[:, 2:]]

    def optimize(p: np.ndarray, cutoff: float):
        return least_squares(fun, p, jac=jac, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', f_scale=cutoff, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=160)

    def mad(v: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(v - np.median(v))))

    grid = np.linspace(zlo, zhi, 8)
    starts = []
    z = target / scale
    for i, a in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for b in grid[i + 1:]:
            A = design(np.array([a, b]))[0][valid][:, keep] / scale[:, None]
            w = np.ones_like(z)
            for _ in range(5):
                c = np.linalg.lstsq(A * w[:, None], z * w, rcond=None)[0]
                r = A @ c - z
                w = 1. / np.hypot(1., r / (2. * max(1e-4, mad(r))))
            starts.append((np.log1p((r / .035)**2).sum(), np.r_[a, (b - a) / (zhi - a), c]))
    pilots = [optimize(p, .035) for _, p in sorted(starts, key=lambda item: item[0])[:4]]
    pilot = min(pilots, key=lambda fit: fit.cost)
    err = design(logs(pilot.x))[0][..., keep] @ pilot.x[2:] - y / ys
    scale = sigma(max(1e-5, mad(err[:, :-1][vc])), max(1e-5, mad(err[:, -1][vr])))
    fits = [optimize(f.x, 2.) for f in pilots]
    fits = [f for f in fits if f.success]
    if not fits:
        raise RuntimeError('Cauchy creep fit did not converge')
    p = min(fits, key=lambda f: f.cost).x
    z = logs(p)
    J = direct_jac(p) / np.hypot(1., fun(p) / 2.)[:, None]
    norms = np.linalg.norm(J, axis=0)
    if z[1] <= z[0] or np.any(norms <= np.finfo(float).eps * norms.max()):
        raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
    sv = np.linalg.svd(J / norms, compute_uv=False)
    if sv[-1] < rank_rtol * sv[0]:
        raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
    c = np.zeros(base + 2)
    c[keep] = p[2:]
    pred = (design(z)[0] @ c) * ys
    hereditary = c[:base] * ys / np.r_[ss, ss, np.full(X.shape[1], ts)]
    plastic = c[base:] * ys / (ts * np.array([ss**2, ss**3]))
    return np.exp(z) * ts, hereditary, plastic, pred[:, :-1] + e0[:, None], pred[:, -1] / ts

def run_self_test():
    cmd = np.linspace(-2., 2., 7)
    clean = 1.07 * cmd + .14
    glitch = clean.copy()
    glitch[3] += 8.
    spots = np.array([.7, .71, .72])
    measured = 1.07 * spots + .142
    measured[-1] -= 5.
    for k in (1., .01):
        g, b, used = calibrate_affine_load(k * cmd[::-1], k * glitch[::-1], 2 * k)
        assert not used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([g, b / k], [1.07, .14], atol=1e-12)
        old = .9 * cmd - .2
        g, b, used = calibrate_affine_load(k * spots, k * measured, 2 * k,
            archive_panels=((k * cmd, k * old), (k * cmd, k * clean)))
        assert used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([g, b / k], [1.07, .142], atol=1e-12)
    with np.testing.assert_raises(ValueError):
        calibrate_affine_load(spots, measured, 2.)

    # Unequal cell sizes and a missing group-stratum combination are supported.
    group = np.array([2, 2, 2, 7, 7, 7])
    stratum = np.array([0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0])
    loc = np.where(group == 2, 10., -5.)[:, None]
    spread = np.where(group == 2, 2., 4.)[:, None]
    ref = loc + spread * np.tile([-np.sqrt(1.5), 0., np.sqrt(1.5)], 2)[:, None]
    raw = loc + spread * np.array([1., 3., 8., 4., np.nan, 6.])[:, None]
    aligned = align_reference_features(raw, ref, group, stratum)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(aligned[:, 0], [1., 3., 8., 4., 5., 6.])
    perm = np.array([3, 1, 5, 4, 2, 0])
    gain = np.where(group == 2, 3., .5)[:, None]
    moved = align_reference_features((gain * raw + loc)[perm],
        (gain * ref + loc)[perm], (12 - group)[perm], (3 + stratum)[perm])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(moved, aligned[perm], atol=1e-12)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(31)
    n = 44
    sy = 2.
    past = rng.uniform(-4., 4., (n, 4))
    hold = rng.uniform(-4., 4., n)
    past[-2], hold[-2] = [-sy, sy, .5, -.5], sy
    past[-1], hold[-1] = [-3.5, .7, 3.2, 1.], -3.
    dt = np.array([.14, .38, .75, .3])
    t = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(.04, 9., 23)]
    X = rng.normal(size=(n, 4))
    e0 = rng.normal(0., .004, n)
    tau = np.array([.42, 2.65])
    w = np.array([.035, .062, .003, .001, -.002, .0007, -.0015])
    vp = np.array([.0028, .0042])

    def truth(p, h, plastic):
        memory = np.zeros((n, 2))
        for j, d in enumerate(dt):
            decay = np.exp(-d / tau)
            memory = decay * memory + (1. - decay) * p[:, j, None]
        amp = (h[:, None] - memory) * w[:2]
        excess = np.maximum(np.abs(h) - sy, 0.)
        drift = w[2] + X @ w[3:] + plastic[0] * np.sign(h) * excess**2
        damage = np.sum(np.maximum(np.abs(p) - sy, 0.)**2 * dt, axis=1)
        amp[:, 0] += plastic[1] * damage * h
        curve = e0[:, None] + amp @ (1. - np.exp(-t[:, None] / tau)).T + drift[:, None] * t
        return curve, (amp / tau).sum(axis=1) + drift

    exact, rate = truth(past, hold, vp)
    no_plastic, no_plastic_rate = truth(past, hold, np.zeros(2))
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(exact[-2], no_plastic[-2])
    assert rate[-2] == no_plastic_rate[-2] and np.max(np.abs(exact[-1] - no_plastic[-1])) > .01
    obs, v = exact.copy(), rate.copy()
    obs[2, 8] += .8
    obs[9, 18] -= .7
    v[6] -= .5
    obs[-2:], v[-2:] = np.nan, np.nan

    def fit(ks, kt):
        return fit_thresholded_creep(ks * past, ks * hold, kt * dt, kt * t,
            X, e0, obs, v / kt, ks * sy, (kt * .17, kt * 8.))

    recovered = fit(1., 1.)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in recovered)
    for actual, target in zip(recovered, (tau, w, vp, exact, rate)):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, target, rtol=2e-4, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(recovered[3][:, 0], e0, atol=1e-14)

    # Stress and time are the dimensional axes here. There is no carrier or
    # reciprocal sensor graph; group/cell relabeling and row permutation above
    # exercise the cohort topology, and calibration uses unordered check pairs.
    ks, kt = .01, .5
    a, b, c, strain, initial_rate = recovered
    scaled = fit(ks, kt)
    expected = (a * kt, b / np.r_[ks, ks, np.full(5, kt)],
                c / (kt * np.array([ks**2, ks**3])), strain, initial_rate / kt)
    for actual, target in zip(scaled, expected):
        assert np.isfinite(actual).all()
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, target, rtol=2e-6, atol=1e-8)

    psub, hsub = np.clip(past, -sy, sy), np.clip(hold, -sy, sy)
    sub_curve, sub_rate = truth(psub, hsub, vp)
    sub = fit_thresholded_creep(psub, hsub, dt, t, X, e0, sub_curve,
                                sub_rate, sy, (.17, 8.))
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in sub)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(sub[2], [0., 0.])

    np.testing.assert_allclose(sub[3], sub_curve, atol=2e-6)
    with np.testing.assert_raises_regex(ValueError, 'identifiable'):
        fit_thresholded_creep(psub, hsub, dt, t, np.c_[X, X[:, 0]], e0,
